trigger.summary: Two score-bearing HSR literals conflict with the authoritative 2025 FTC schedule applicable to the task's 2025 transaction events.

delta_units.before: C-040 requires the 2025 HSR size-of-transaction threshold to be USD 119.5 million.
delta_units.after: The applicable 2025 size-of-transaction threshold is USD 126.4 million.

evidence.proposition: The 2025 size-of-transaction threshold is USD 126.4 million.

governing_time.value_or_ref: Task transaction dates in April-August 2025, after 2025-02-21.

delta_units.before: C-039 requires a USD 160,000 filing fee for the USD 425 million transaction.
delta_units.after: The applicable 2025 filing fee for the USD 425 million transaction is USD 105,000.

evidence.proposition: A USD 425 million transaction falls in the USD 105,000 fee band.

governing_time.value_or_ref: Task transaction dates in April-August 2025, after 2025-02-21.

actions: Revise C-040 from USD 119.5 million to USD 126.4 million for the task's 2025 time state.
Revise C-039 from USD 160,000 to USD 105,000 for the USD 425 million transaction.

result_impact.scope: Any result scored against C-039/C-040 at the pinned defective task revision under the task's 2025 transaction dates.
result_impact.reason: Authoritative 2025 values can be falsely rejected while stale rubric values can pass; historical raw outputs must be inspected to decide whether re-judging is sufficient.

open_questions: Whether historical raw outputs for the affected task revision remain available for re-judging.
Whether the upstream maintainer accepts the proposed legal correction.

adjudication.note: Needle has not received upstream maintainer or qualified external adjudication of the proposed repair.
